name: gow3-dev-guard
description: Two-layer deterministic guardrails for the gow3_pc fork: PreToolUse blocks dangerous operations before execution (fail-closed, cd-tracking, git staged/worktree inspection); the trusted-source Audit Gate (audit_gate.py, CLI+CI via hardened pull_request_target — eligible required check, PR head as data only) verifies the repository's real changes against a trusted reference with unconditional proprietary checks, security surfaces (.github/workflows, zcode/) requiring maintainer approval records on the trusted ref, and blob-proven upstream exceptions (windows-v2.1.7 @ b907d8a9); Stop validates the GOW3 ZCODE FINAL REPORT; SessionStart injects context.
